workshop.provenance.density.concrete: Concrete: 2,400 kg/m³, usual order of magnitude not found in docs/research, to be validated.

workshop.provenance.fasteners.bracketSpa: Maximum spacing of wall handrail brackets: no value in docs/research; 1000 mm to be validated (number of brackets = length / spacing rounded up, plus one).
workshop.provenance.fasteners.diameter: Nominal diameter when the joint has no sized hole: no value in docs/research, to be validated (manufacturer's data sheet).
workshop.provenance.fasteners.grade: Fixing grade or material: no value in docs/research, to be validated (exposure, material of the joined parts).
workshop.provenance.fasteners.holeCleara: Minimum hole clearance (nominal diameter = largest diameter of the series that fits the hole with this clearance): no value in docs/research; 1 mm to be validated (M12 in a 13 or 14 mm hole, M16 in an 18 mm hole).
workshop.provenance.fasteners.kind: Type of fixing for the substrate (bolt, anchor, coach screw…): no figured rule in docs/research (C §2.7), to be validated against the manufacturer's ETA.
workshop.provenance.fasteners.length: Fixing length: no value in docs/research, to be validated (clamped thicknesses, embedment per the manufacturer's ETA).
workshop.provenance.fasteners.nominalDia: Nominal diameter series of the fixings: M3, M4, M5, M6, M8, M10, M12, M16, M20, M24, M30 (first-choice metric threads), no source in docs/research, to be validated.
workshop.provenance.fasteners.perPoint: Quantity per fixing point (hole, post, handrail bracket): no value in docs/research, to be validated.
workshop.provenance.fasteners.unknownWal: Wall of a wall-mounted handrail not described by the site (wall imposed by the project): assumed load-bearing (mechanical anchor), to be validated.
workshop.provenance.metal.barLengths: C-M-08 / C §4.3: bars of 6 m or 12 m ([46], medium confidence).
workshop.provenance.metal.bendLaws: Minimum radii and flanges: “classic values” for steel Rm 40–45 daN/mm² (C §2.6 [17], medium confidence); method and K factor to be validated (CHALLENGE G5).
workshop.provenance.metal.defaultK: K factor 0.33 unsourced (CHALLENGE G5): to be validated by a pilot bending shop.
workshop.provenance.metal.density: 7,850 kg/m³: usual value for steel (EN 1991-1-1 annex A, not read), not found in docs/research.
workshop.provenance.metal.laser: Maximum laser cutting thickness: no value in docs/research; 20 mm to be validated.
workshop.provenance.metal.plateRolling: Plate rolls (milestone 5b): C §2.4 [16] only gives r_min ≈ 0.65 × Ø of the top roll; minimum inner radius 150 mm, rolls of 2,000 mm and 12 mm thickness to be validated by the workshop.
workshop.provenance.metal.pressBrake: C-M-04: 2,980 mm and 8 mm, online S235 subcontractor (C §2.6 [18], medium confidence); example values to be replaced by the workshop's press brake.
workshop.provenance.metal.profileBending: C-M-06 / C-M-07: bending radii of a section bender (C §2.3 [15], medium confidence, machine-specific); no data for HEA.
workshop.provenance.metal.sawKerf: Saw kerf 3 mm: no value in docs/research, to be validated.
workshop.provenance.metal.sheetFormats: C §4.3: 3,000 × 1,500, 4,000 × 2,000, 6,000 × 2,000 “common in the trade, to be confirmed” (no reliable source).
workshop.provenance.wood.clearance: Joint clearances of DTU 36.3 (RC 10) not found in open access (C §1.1).
workshop.provenance.wood.densities: No density in docs/research: orders of magnitude to be validated.
workshop.provenance.wood.housingDepth: 15 mm to be validated; sourced lower bound: housing ≥ 14 mm (NF EN 16481 § 5.4.2, C §1.4).
workshop.provenance.wood.lengthAllowance: Cutting length allowance (C §1.6 quotes it as a parameter, without a value).
workshop.provenance.wood.minPerpendicula: Minimum perpendicular width (CHALLENGE G6), no sourced value.
workshop.provenance.wood.minUpperOffset: Projection d_h (B §4.1: “workshop parameter”), no sourced value.
workshop.provenance.wood.minWoodBetweenH: Timber between mortises (CHALLENGE G6), no sourced value.
workshop.provenance.wood.postSections: Newel post sections unsourced (C §1.9 quotes a finished newel post of 90 to 100 mm, low confidence).
